question: _____ had I arrived home when the phone rang.
explanation: Hardly/Scarcely/Barely + had + sujeto + participio pasado se usa para la inversión con el pasado perfecto (past perfect).

question: _____ does she complain about her workload.
explanation: Los adverbios negativos como rarely, seldom, hardly requieren inversión: Rarely + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Not only _____ the exam, but he also got the highest score.
explanation: Not only requiere inversión: Not only + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Under no circumstances _____ this door unlocked.
explanation: Las expresiones negativas requieren inversión: Under no circumstances + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: _____ had we started the meeting when the fire alarm went off.
explanation: No sooner + had + sujeto + participio pasado + than se usa para expresar sucesión inmediata.

question: Little _____ that this decision would change everything.
explanation: Little (que significa 'not much') requiere inversión: Little + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Never before _____ such a beautiful sunset.
explanation: Never requiere inversión: Never + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Only after finishing the project _____ how difficult it was.
explanation: Only + expresión de tiempo requiere inversión: Only after + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: _____ will I agree to such unreasonable terms.
explanation: In no way es una expresión negativa que requiere inversión.

question: Seldom _____ such dedication in a young employee.
explanation: Seldom requiere inversión: Seldom + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Not until midnight _____ working on the report.
explanation: Not until requiere inversión: Not until + tiempo + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: _____ the door than the lights went out.
explanation: No sooner + had + sujeto + participio pasado + than.

question: At no time _____ that the project would fail.
explanation: At no time requiere inversión: At no time + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Only when you lose something _____ its true value.
explanation: Only when requiere inversión en la cláusula principal.

question: _____ such a talented musician.
explanation: Rarely al inicio de la oración requiere inversión: Rarely + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: Not a word _____ during the entire meeting.
explanation: Not a + sustantivo requiere inversión: Not a word + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: _____ the importance of this decision.
explanation: Little + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo para dar énfasis.

question: Only by working together _____ this challenge.
explanation: Only by + -ing requiere inversión: Only by + auxiliar + sujeto + verbo.

question: _____ to such a ridiculous proposal.
explanation: Never al inicio de la oración requiere inversión para dar énfasis.

question: Not only _____ late, but he also forgot the documents.
explanation: Not only + verbo 'be' + sujeto (inversión con 'be').
